integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact Fourier integral, Cauchy-Schwarz symmetrization, exact rational derivative factorization, and phase equality conditions. Symbolic and random checks are supplemental.

scientific_limitations: Sharp only for harmonic Poisson polynomials with five frequencies -2 through 2. This is strictly below known unrestricted lower bounds, so it is not a new unrestricted embedding estimate. Unindexed equivalent finite-bandwidth work remains possible; one older relevant paper was inspected only to preview level.
title: Sharp fourth-power Poisson embedding on the quadratic harmonic Fourier band
